'''Jog Saveen''' was a [[Force Adept]] tainted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Like many individuals touched by the dark side, she faced the possibility of experiencing the debilitating long-term effects of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends#Corruption_of_the_dark_side|dark side corruption]].<ref name="DSS" />
